title: Mean curvature as the normal part of the Gram trace of a chart Hessian
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝᴺ, y ∈ ℝᴺ, A : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ an injective continuous linear map and S : ℝⁿ →L[ℝ] ℝⁿ →L[ℝ] ℝᴺ a continuous bilinear map. Suppose tangentSpace M y = range A and secondFundamentalForm M y (A a) (A b) = normalPart M y (S a b) for all a, b ∈ ℝⁿ. Let e_k := EuclideanSpace.single k 1 (k ∈ Fin n) be the standard basis of ℝⁿ, G := A* ∘ A (A* = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A) and G⁻¹ := Ring.inverse G its inverse in the ring ℝⁿ →L[ℝ] ℝⁿ (multiplication = composition). Then meanCurvature M y = normalPart M y (Σ_{k,l ∈ Fin n} ⟨e_k, G⁻¹ e_l⟩ • S e_k e_l).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (y : Rn N) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N) (S : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N), Function.Injective A → tangentSpace M y = LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap → (∀ a b : Rn n, secondFundamentalForm M y (A a) (A b) = normalPart M y (S a b)) → meanCurvature M y = normalPart M y (∑ k : Fin n, ∑ l : Fin n, inner ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ)) (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L A) (EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ))) • S (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ)) (EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ)))
